messages:
Marta: Quick check-in: we need a tight plan for the Orbit IAC deliverables for the Cloud Partner listing. Deliverables: TF module, tiny example, marketplace metadata, 2 diagrams, CI smoke. Target: staging publish next Wed.
Leo: I'll take the TF module scaffolding + examples/basic. Will follow our modules/ examples/ tests/ pattern.
Ash: I'll do CI + matrix for x86/arm and add `terraform fmt -check` enforcer in workflow.
Vivian: I'll own the README/ref-arch doc and the two PNG diagrams (logical + ops). Will include a 3-step quickstart and an observability checklist.
Marta: constraints: listing blurb <=200 chars, icon 64x64 PNG, must include LICENSE and contributor guide.
Leo: note: set `required_version = ">= 1.5"` and a short providers section in README.
Ash: CI snippet I plan to add:
```
name: iac-smoke
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        arch: [x86, arm]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v2
      - run: terraform init -input=false
      - run: terraform validate
      - run: terraform fmt -check
```
Vivian: diagrams: I'll include mermaid sources alongside PNGs, and a short YAML for alerts (latency, KV cache hit %, disk pressure).
Marta: Packaging checklist: no customer data in screenshots, include region support table (aws/gcp), and add a short migration note for customers on older modules.
Leo: I'll add examples/complete with an optional monitoring hook (Datadog snippet). Also create minimal smoke-vars.tf for CI.
Ash: agree to pre-commit hooks with tflint and fmt. I'll add .pre-commit-config and GH Action step to run the checks.
Vivian: timeline: today owners set. Mon - PRs for module + docs. Tue - CI matrix + assets. Wed - publish to partner staging and run smoke tests.
partner-bot: REMINDER: upload packaging assets to /partner-artifacts and run `./scripts/validate-marketplace.sh` to auto-verify metadata.
Marta: Great — Leo/Ash/Vivian, please link PRs in the tracker and tag me. Who will do alpha sign-off after staging?
Leo: I can do a quick verification if CI + staging smoke are green.
Ash: I'll run the CI validation and post results in the PR.
Vivian: I'll push the first draft of diagrams tonight.
Marta: Thanks everyone. I'll create the tracking ticket and assign tasks. :thumbsup:
